A '''battle''' was fought during the [[Tionese War]] near [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. During the battle, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was hit by [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[pressure bomb]]s.<ref name="TEGtW" />
